newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea's Halla Group cuts executive numbers.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea's Halla Group cuts executive numbers.

text.p: South Korea's 12th-ranked Halla Group said on Thursday it had reduced the number of group executives by up to 15 percent to improve efficiency.
A Halla statement said it had accepted the resignation of officials above the director level in Halla affiliates and had replaced presidents in the cement and concrete units.

The statement said the reduction was part of an effort to "establish a new era" under second-generation chairman Chung Mong-won, who in January assumed his post from his father, former chairman and founder Chung In-yung. -- Seoul Newsroom (822) 727 5647
